title: Partner With Us | Visa Partnerships for Travel Agents | UVS
description: Partner with us: travel agents, tour operators, universities and businesses can offer clients reliable visa services through Unique Visa Services.
intro: If you work with people who travel or move to the UK, you can partner with us to give them a reliable, regulated visa service, while you focus on what you do best.

sections.heading: Who we partner with
sections.text:
We work with organisations whose clients need visas, including:
- Travel agents and tour operators
- Umrah and Hajj travel organisers
- Universities, colleges and student recruitment agents
- Event, conference and trade fair organisers
- Businesses and HR teams with travelling staff
- Community organisations

sections.heading: What partners get
sections.text:
When you partner with us, you get:
- A dedicated contact for your clients' applications
- Clear, agreed pricing, with partner rates for regular volumes
- Online application forms you can share with clients, with passport details filled in automatically
- Regular status updates, so you can keep your clients informed
- Fast, accurate applications prepared by an IAA-regulated team

sections.heading: How partnership works
sections.text:
Partnerships start with a conversation about your clients, the destinations they travel to, and the volume of applications. We then agree how you'll refer clients, how we'll keep you updated, and the pricing that applies.

For travel visas, eVisas and document legalisation, we offer partner rates and can discuss commission arrangements. For UK immigration advice, we follow the Immigration Advice Authority's rules on referral arrangements, and we always tell clients about any arrangement that applies to them.

sections.heading: Partner with us in Manchester and across the UK
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and work with partners across the UK. To partner with us, contact us with a few details about your organisation and your clients, and we'll arrange a call.

faqs.q: Do you pay commission to partners?
faqs.a: For travel visas and document services, we can discuss partner rates and commission. For UK immigration advice, we follow the IAA’s rules on referral arrangements.
Yes. You can share our online application forms with your clients, and we keep you updated on progress.
